Definition: properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult
BiblicalUsage: 1) to insult, shame, humiliate, blush, be ashamed, be put to shame, be reproached, be put to confusion, be humiliated; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be humiliated, be ashamed; 1a2) to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to put to shame, insult, humiliate, cause shame to; 1b2) to exhibit shame; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be insulted, be humiliated; 1c2) to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
